environment.description: Node.js 18 Express application deployed on an EC2 instance behind a classic ELB with no additional header injection. The application is accessed directly via the ELB DNS endpoint. No reverse proxy or CDN layer adds security headers. The ELB performs TCP passthrough on port 443 with TLS termination at the instance level using a self-signed certificate.

config.network: Public subnet, security group allows 0.0.0.0/0 on port 443
